alerts.message: Regime watch: evidence building toward Stagflation (Q3) — 3 day(s) so far; the quad label flips after 7
alerts.message_zh: 周期预警：证据正在累积，指向 滞胀（Q3）— 已持续 3 天；标签将在第 7 天翻转
alerts.plain_en: Regime radar moved — the HK quad may be flipping
alerts.plain_zh: 周期雷达变动 — 香港象限可能正在翻转
alerts.what_en: The growth/inflation quad needs a pending reading to hold a week before the label flips. Evidence is now stacking toward a new quad — re-check your tilt before it confirms.
alerts.what_zh: 增长／通胀象限需「待定」读数持续一周才翻转标签。证据正在累积指向新的象限 —在确认前重新检视配置。
alerts.edge_en: High — a quad shift re-prices the sector tilt downstream.
alerts.edge_zh: 高 — 象限转变会重新定价其下游的板块配置。

alerts.message: Overnight HIBOR spiked to +2.5σ (now 3.85%) — HK funding is tightening; a squeeze pressures rate-sensitive HK names
alerts.message_zh: 隔夜 HIBOR 飙升至 +2.5σ（现 3.85%）— 香港资金面收紧；挤压利率敏感的港股
alerts.plain_zh: 隔夜 HIBOR 飙升 — 资金挤压
alerts.what_en: HIBOR is HK's interbank rate (it shadows the Fed via the peg). A sharp overnight spike signals a funding squeeze that pressures leveraged and rate-sensitive HK names.
alerts.what_zh: HIBOR 是香港银行同业拆息（经联汇跟随美联储）。隔夜急升预示资金挤压，挤压杠杆与利率敏感的港股。
alerts.edge_en: Medium — a funding squeeze pressures leveraged/rate-sensitive names.
alerts.edge_zh: 中 — 资金挤压压制杠杆与利率敏感标的。
